The files formalize harmonic grammar expressivity (OT/HG/MaxEnt containment, cumulativity, realizability), partially ordered constraints in OT (linear extensions, antimatroids, stratified grammars, quantitative interpretation), constraint rankings (total orders, permutations, ERC encoding), autosegmental representations (axioms, normal forms, OCP, factors, correspondences), feature geometry, segmental phonology (PHOIBLE, feature classes), tonal phonology (plateauing, constraints), subregular phonology (SL/SP/TSL, BMRS, forbidden factors, crossings, dependence, aperiodicity), dependency grammar (dominance, projectivity, crossings, length, reordering), minimalist syntax (merge, movement, agree, linearization, phases, probes), agreement geometry, case systems, adjective syntax, coordinators, and command relations. None are pure import aggregators, generated data, transcripts, or stubs. All 73 files stay in the primary search index.
